units.source_en: the curse of Cain] See Genesis iv 11–14:

paragraphs.source_en:
And now art thou cursed from the earth, which hath opened her mouth to receive thy
brother’s blood from thy hand; When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield
unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth. And Cain said
unto the Lord, My punishment is greater than I can bear. Behold, thou hast driven me out
this day from the face of the earth; and from thy face shall I be hid; and I shall be a fugitive
and a vagabond in the earth; and it shall come to pass, that every one that findeth me shall
slay me.
